task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the asset management interface (Snipe-IT) to view the list of laptops.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A browser window showing the Snipe-IT dashboard or 'All Assets' table with columns for Asset Name, Asset Tag, and Department.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies the specific assets belonging to the Engineering department and their respective locations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the agent filtering by the 'Engineering' department or clicking on specific assets (ASSET-8001, 8002, 8003, 8004) to view their details.

task_completion.description: Rename Engineering assets in London (ASSET-8001, ASSET-8002) to the LON-ENG- prefix.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Edit Asset' page or a success message showing 'Asset Name' updated to 'LON-ENG-ASSET-8001' and 'LON-ENG-ASSET-8002'.

task_completion.description: Rename Engineering asset in Berlin (ASSET-8003) to the BER-ENG- prefix.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Edit Asset' page or a success message showing 'Asset Name' updated to 'BER-ENG-ASSET-8003'.

task_completion.description: Rename Engineering asset in Tokyo (ASSET-8004) to the TYO-ENG- prefix.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Edit Asset' page or a success message showing 'Asset Name' updated to 'TYO-ENG-ASSET-8004'.

task_completion.description: Ensure Marketing and unassigned assets remain unchanged.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final asset list view shows ASSET-8005, ASSET-8006 (Marketing) and ASSET-8007 (Ready to Deploy) with their original names/tags, not following the new convention.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicking 'Edit' buttons, and typing into web forms rather than a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with individual asset records to ensure accuracy per location.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the agent opening the edit page for different assets one by one.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus rather than jumping directly to known URLs.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on the 'Assets' sidebar or using the search bar within the Snipe-IT UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target hostnames that must be present after remediation are: 'LON-ENG-ASSET-8001', 'LON-ENG-ASSET-8002', 'BER-ENG-ASSET-8003', and 'TYO-ENG-ASSET-8004'. Assets 'ASSET-8005' and 'ASSET-8006' belong to Marketing and must NOT be renamed. Asset 'ASSET-8007' is 'Ready to Deploy' (unassigned) and must NOT be renamed.
